ns2:course.label: Special Courses
ns2:course.description: Experimental and temporary courses. May be repeated as topics vary. 1 to 5 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
